title: Cash Pickup Hold, Information-Request and Error-Claim Time Limits
content:
Compliance and the error-resolution team work to five time limits on Cash Pickup transfers, set per tier:

- the calendar days a customer has to answer a request for information about one transfer before the transfer is cancelled;
- the Paloma business days compliance takes to clear a hold once the request is answered;
- the calendar days after the disclosed date of availability within which an error notice may be given;
- the calendar days after an error notice within which Paloma must decide it;
- the Paloma business days within which money is made available again after the customer chooses re-issue as a remedy.

| Cash Pickup tier | Days to answer a request for information (calendar) | Hold cleared within (business days of a complete answer) | Error notice window (calendar days after disclosed availability) | Decision due within (calendar days of the notice) | Re-issue made available within (business days of the choice) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 10 | 2 | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 7 | 1 | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 7 | 1 | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 10 | 2 | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 7 | 1 | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 14 | 3 | 180 | 90 | 2 |

## Remarks

- The error notice window of 180 days and the decision period of 90 days are the same on every tier.
- Cash Pickup Large Amount allows the longest time to answer a request for information (14 days) and the longest hold review (3 business days). It also allows the longest re-issue period (2 business days).
